title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
content: The Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme is a non-contributory old-age pension scheme. Government service information describes eligibility for Indian citizens aged 60 years and above who live below the poverty line, subject to the applicable implementation rules.

title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
content: Application and implementation procedures can vary by state or union territory. Applicants should use the relevant government service portal or designated service channel for their location.

title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
content: The exact application process and required documents may depend on the state or union territory. Users should verify the local implementation details before applying.
